Resources | Monroe County

Practical services that support pets and people in Monroe County - from nail trims and microchipping to membership and volunteer opportunities.

Shelter services

We offer pet nail trims and microchipping by appointment. Call the shelter to schedule, ask about pricing, or learn what to bring the day of your visit.
